method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (ltma-core.l4, with seven regulative rules) and a seat layer (ltma-seat.l4, 22 questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (special trusts, non-concessional companies, anything needing the Land Tax Management Regulation 2024, years before 2009 and partly non-residential surcharge land answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Land Tax Management Act 1956 No 26, NSW Legislation version 2024-12-02 (nsw_legislation:2024-12-02/act-1956-026), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1956-026.txt; with the Land Tax Act 1956 No 27, version 2024-12-02 (nsw_legislation:2024-12-02/act-1956-027), deposited at ../../../land-tax-act-1956/registers/source-bundle/act-1956-027.txt. Both from the Open Australian Legal Corpus 7.1.0 as collected on 10 March 2025 (owner's decision of 2026-10-20): NOT the current official text and may be out of date. The s 62P and s 62S thresholds are encoded as stated ($1,075,000 and $6,571,000 for every year after 2023); for the 2025 and later land tax years they must be checked against the current register. Land values, any land value adjustment, the Treasurer's s 40 discount rate and the Taxation Administration Act 1996 s 89 objection period are inputs.

checks.result: 162 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 8 #TRACEs with an expect line (6 breaches, 2 obligations pending), each read and as expected; a deliberately failing control assertion was reported as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the individual owner of land in NSW (including joint owners and a foreign person liable to surcharge): Land Tax Management Act ss 7, 8, 9(1)-(4), 9AA(1), (2), (6), (7), (11); s 10(1)(r) and Schedule 1A cll 1-9, 11-15 (with Schedule 2 cl 70); s 12(1A)-(1B) (regulative); s 27(2)-(4) with ss 33-34; ss 39(1), (3) and 40 (regulative); ss 62P and 62S as tables; Schedule 1A cl 6(5)-(6), cl 7(3A)-(4) and cl 12(2)-(5) as regulative rules. Land Tax Act s 3AL(1), (2)(a), (5) and Schedule 13 Part 1; s 5A(1)-(4); s 5B(1)-(4) (the 200-day residence requirement regulative). Not covered (asserted): Schedule 13 Parts 2-4 (special trusts, non-concessional companies), anything needing the Land Tax Management Regulation 2024 (prescribed lessees, s 5BA retirement visa holders), years before 2009, s 5A(4)(d). Out: other s 10 exemptions, s 10AA, ss 9A-9E (one adjustment input only), ss 10Q-10R, s 3AL(6)-(9) and s 73, Land Tax Act ss 5C, 5CA, 5D, 5A(5), Schedule 1AA, Schedule 1A cl 8(3), 10, 10A, 10AA, 10B, ss 20-26, the Taxation Administration Act 1996. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991/ (carer payment, Schedule 1A cl 8(5)(c)), subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997/ (rental deduction and Subdivision 118-B, unverified links) and subjects/au/nsw/duties-act-1997/ (Chapter 2A terms); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
